target.title: test(qa): run the real CLI channel picker
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `cli-channel-picker` QA scenario only linked to mocked Vitest coverage, so it could report maturity coverage without launching the product CLI, crossing the interactive prompt boundary, or proving that onboarding persisted configuration.

## Why This Change Was Made

Convert the scenario to a script-backed producer that:

- forces a fresh CLI startup build;
- launches `openclaw configure --section channels` through the existing PTY helper under an isolated `OPENCLAW_HOME`;
- drives the real picker through Telegram setup and the final DM-policy prompt;
- requires successful process exit and validates the written plugin, channel, mention-gate, and wizard metadata;
- emits the shared QA script evidence envelope with a sanitized transcript and config-assertion artifact;
- terminates stalled processes and records failed evidence instead of accepting a preview or helper-only simulation.

This PR is AI-assisted. I reviewed the implementation and understand the behavior and evidence paths.

## User Impact

No product behavior changes. QA coverage for the CLI channel picker now proves the real interactive user path and persisted configuration, making release and maturity evidence more trustworthy.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/e2e/qa-lab/config/cli-channel-picker.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-catalog.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/test-file-scenario-runner.test.ts --reporter=verbose` — 51 tests passed.
- Local script producer — forced a fresh `cliStartup` build, completed the real picker, wrote Telegram configuration, emitted `pass` evidence, and retained no synthetic token fragments.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwn6kjp1fkegvvvmyve07hcb` — `check:changed` passed, then a fresh-build real picker run passed with config and artifact assertions. Crabbox wrapper result: `exitCode=0`, `runStatus=succeeded`, `commandMs=302715`, `totalMs=315947`, `syncDelegated=true`.
- Backing hydration run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28688489845 — the Testbox step may appear cancelled after the successful command because the one-shot wrapper stops the externally managed lease; the wrapper JSON above is the command result per the repository Testbox contract.
- PR CI for exact head `f0d18fe9deb38a0bba0346b0da2d8f0c75a38169` — 54 relevant checks succeeded with no failures.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --prompt-file /tmp/cli-picker-review-notes.md --stream-engine-output` — clean; no accepted/actionable findings.
